name: EMPIAR-10180
title: Pre-catalytic spliceosome
notes: One stack per micrograph, as RELION extracts them, under the Micrographs_* directories: between 5 and 109 particles each, 67 on average. The consensus STAR file names them, and has the poses and the CTF of every particle.
The STAR file is of RELION 3.0, with no optics, so it states no box: replaying its layout takes --dataset.box.

variants.name: D=128 and D=256, in one stack
variants.recipe: cryodrgn downsample Example/consensus_data.star --datadir . -D 256 -o particles.256.mrcs, which writes every particle into one stack, as cryoDRGN reads them.

variants.name: float16 on disk, one stack per micrograph
variants.recipe: python examples/python/basic/convert.py on each stack, with --data-type float16, into a tree of the same names, and the STAR file pointed at it.

variants.name: The layout alone
variants.recipe: python -m vitrio_bench generate --datadir DIR --dataset.like=Example/consensus_data.star --dataset.box=320 makes noise in stacks of the same sizes, without downloading the particles.
